A3-01.atk: a small shortbow string snaps with a light twang, a thin arrow whistles off on a puff of wind, then a soft wooden tock as it lands
A3-01.def: no armour, the young archer stumbles back: a soft cloth rustle, a startled gasp of air, a dropped arrow clattering on stone

A3-02.ko: 작은 깃 쏘아 틈 꿰뚫음 · 날개 퍼덕이며 휘청
A3-02.atk: a young harpy screeches and flings a single sharp feather with a flick of its wing: a thin whistle, then a precise piercing tick through a gap
A3-02.def: no armour, it flaps backward: a flurry of messy feathers, a startled squawk, talons scrabbling on stone

A3-04.ko: 소리 없이 내려와 발톱 · 깃 부풀려 버팀
A3-04.atk: near-silent wings glide down with only a soft hush of air, a single low hoot, then talons grip with a sharp scratch
A3-04.def: the owl puffs up its feathers: a soft muffled thump, a ruffle of plumage, a calm two-note hoot

A3-05.ko: 바람 칼날 휙 · 바람 속으로 흩어짐
A3-05.atk: an airy laugh, a light swirling whoosh, then a thin blade of wind slices past with a crisp whistle
A3-05.def: the blow passes through a body of air: a breathy rush, a scatter of caught leaves, the gust gathering back with a soft whistle

A3-07.ko: 돌풍 채어 와 꽂음 · 깔깔대며 날아 빠짐
A3-07.atk: a high giggle, a sudden snatching gust, then a quick spinning wind dart jabs through armour with a sharp pop
A3-07.def: the imp tumbles away on the breeze: a squeaky yelp, tiny wings buzzing, a puff of air scattering

A3-09.ko: 날개 접고 시위 퉁 · 깃 팔로 받음
A3-09.atk: a beak clicks, folded wings rustle, then a bowstring twangs and an arrow thuds into wood
A3-09.def: feathered arms come up: a soft feather whump, a leather bracer knock, a short indignant chirp

A3-10.ko: 깃화살 다다닥 연사 · 깃털 흩날리며 비틀
A3-10.atk: rapid wing flicks fire a flurry of feathers: a fast staccato of whistling quills and a scatter of small piercing thunks
A3-10.def: the harpy wobbles in the air: a messy burst of loose feathers, a squawk, a clumsy wing beat

A3-11.ko: 날개 치며 쏜살 돌진 · 휙 비켜섬
A3-11.atk: small wings beat fast, a squeaky screech, then a tumbling dive ends in a light talon scratch and a beak peck
A3-11.def: the cub hops aside: a quick flap, a little chirping growl, the blow whooshing past

A3-13.ko: 빗속 급강하해 발톱 · 젖은 깃으로 가림
A3-13.atk: rain hisses, a sharp eagle screech, then a dive with a rush of wet wings and a heavy talon strike
A3-13.def: rain-soaked feathers flare wide around the blow: a wet heavy wing flap, a sharp snort, hooves splashing back in a puddle

A3-15.ko: 숨 멈추고 한 발 · 바람 흩어 빗나감
A3-15.atk: a long silent bowstring draw creaking slowly, a held breath, then one clean sharp release and a precise piercing thunk
A3-15.def: the sniper twists aside at the last instant: a crisp swish of air, the attack slicing nothing but wind, a light landing step

A3-16.ko: 급강하해 갑옷 틈 꿰뚫음 · 몸 틀어 흘림
A3-16.atk: a thin shriek high above, a fast whistling stoop, then talons slip through an armour joint with a precise metallic tick
A3-16.def: the falcon twists in flight: a quick feather flick, the blow glancing off with a swish of air

A3-18.ko: 별 둘이 번갈아 쏨 · 별빛 시위로 쳐냄
A3-18.atk: two starlit bowstrings hum in turn, one shimmering arrow whistles off and a second rides its wake, landing in a doubled crystalline chime
A3-18.def: a bowstring of starlight snaps up to deflect: a bright twang, faint chiming sparks, the star lines flickering

A3-19.ko: 오만하게 당긴 장궁 · 펼친 날개가 바람 튕김
A3-19.atk: a long bow creaks in a slow proud draw, a beak clicks, then a heavy release and an arrow splits the wind with a clean crack
A3-19.def: wings snap open in a gust: a firm feather slap, a buffet of air turning the blow, a sharp chirp

A3-20.ko: 책장 넘기며 별 문자 번뜩 · 책장이 겹쳐 막음
A3-20.atk: pages riffle in a gust of wind, a star glyph lifts off with a clear bell tone, then it lances straight through armour with a bright glassy chime
A3-20.def: the book snaps half shut: a dry thick vellum clap, pages fanning with a rustle, silver clasps clinking

A3-22.ko: 바람 멎는 틈에 내리꽂힘 · 기류 타고 흘림
A3-22.atk: the wind suddenly falls silent, then wings fold and a griffin plunges with a rising whistle, landing in a heavy talon strike and a screech
A3-22.def: it slips the blow on a shifting current: a soft rush of air, a wing tilting with a feathered swish

A3-23.ko: 별빛 꼬리 휘두름 · 가볍게 뛰어 넘김
A3-23.atk: light paws patter, a sharp yip, then a starlit tail sweeps with a twinkling chime and a quick nip
A3-23.def: the fox bounds aside: a soft scrabble of paws, a shimmer of starlight trailing, a teasing bark

A3-24.atk: a crow-like caw, a feather fan snaps open, a bowstring twangs and an arrow crackles with lightning before striking with a sharp electric crack
A3-24.def: a puff of storm cloud swallows the hit: a soft cloudy whump, a fizz of static, black feathers rustling

A3-26.ko: 폭풍 쫓아 사냥 돌진 · 폭풍에 휘감김
A3-26.atk: thunder rumbles in the distance, hooves gallop then lift into heavy wing beats, a screech, and a crushing talon strike
A3-26.def: a swirl of storm wind wraps it: a gusty roar, a wet wing flap, a snort as it rights itself

A3-28.atk: a whistling streak of sparks, a high giggle, then a small blazing head-butt pops with a crackle of starfire
A3-28.def: the imp scatters into sparks: a fizzing burst, a tiny yelp, embers twinkling back into place

A3-29.ko: 별자리 활 한 발 · 별선이 단단히 버팀
A3-29.atk: lines of starlight stretch into a great bow, a long shimmering draw, then a single star arrow looses with a deep crystalline twang and a ringing hit
A3-29.def: the constellation holds its shape: star points chiming as the blow passes between them, a low steady starlight hum

A3-30.atk: a gust of storm wind howls, a fierce shriek, then a stooping dive ends in a hard talon smack and a thunder pop
A3-30.def: wings sweep across the body: a sharp feather whoosh, a blast of wind, a defiant cry

A3-31.ko: 흩어진 바람 속 정확한 한 발 · 바람 속 바위가 막음
A3-31.atk: chaotic crosswinds whirling, a patient heavy bowstring release, an arrow holding true through the turbulence and cracking into stone
A3-31.def: small floating rocks swirl into the blow's path: gritty stone clacks, scraping pebbles, a whistling eddy around the body

A3-32.ko: 회오리 셋 꿰는 한 발 · 겹겹이 도는 바람
A3-32.atk: a fan swings three times, three whirlwinds spin up roaring, then one arrow threads them all with a rising whistle and a sharp crack
A3-32.def: layered whirlwinds circle the tengu: a deep rushing roar, the blow tossed aside, feathers fluttering

A3-33.ko: 별을 겨눈 별똥별 돌진 · 별빛이 깜박
A3-33.atk: a long rising whistle as a blazing streak climbs, a hiss of trailing sparks, then a bright booming impact and a shower of crackling embers
A3-33.def: the falling star flickers under the blow: a fizzing dim, a soft glassy pulse, then its glow blazes back

A3-34.ko: 번개 왕관 아래 깃 폭풍 · 구름이 첫 타격 흡수
A3-34.atk: thunder rolls over a crown of cloud, a commanding screech, then a storm of razor feathers tears through armour with crackling sparks
A3-34.def: the crowning thundercloud swallows the first blow: a soft cloudy boom, a crackle of static, a furious wing snap

A3-35.ko: 거대 날개로 하늘 가름 · 육중한 깃이 막음
A3-35.atk: a colossal wing beat booms like a sail cracking in a gale, a deafening cry, then a sweeping talon strike tears through the air with a long ripping roar
A3-35.def: massive feathers take the hit: a deep heavy thump, a gust of wind, a low rumbling cry

A3-36.atk: an ancient great bow creaks under a mighty draw, a booming twang echoes like a tower bell, a massive arrow howls through storm wind
A3-36.def: the whole tower seems to brace with its lord: a deep stone groan, rattling banners in the gale, a heavy settled stance

A3-41.ko: 구름 몸으로 덮어 누름 · 칼바람 숨 죽임
A3-41.atk: a deep slow whale call hums through thick air, a vast cloud body drifts forward with a soft whoosh, then smothers the foe in a muffled hush
A3-41.def: the blow sinks into cloud: a soft pillowy whump, wind dying to silence, a distant low whale call

A3-42.ko: 폭풍 눈의 바람 가시 · 고요 단단하게 막음
A3-42.atk: a vast eye blinks with a deep soft thump, the storm hushes, then a thorn of compressed air jabs out with a short stinging whistle
A3-42.def: a calm unblinking core inside a roaring storm: a deep wall of wind rings out, a heavy thud, then a thin counter-slash of spiking air

SP-A3.ko: 별빛 화살 연발 · 별빛 장벽 울림
SP-A3.atk: starry crackles gather, a luminous bowstring-like thrum with no arrow, then multiple streaking star-bolts whistle and burst on impact with a deep boom
SP-A3.def: a luminous wall of ascended wind: a high crystalline chime, a deep cosmic hum, the strike scattering into twinkling glass-like sparks

UN-A3.ko: 망루에서 미리 겨눈 화살 · 주문을 미리 흩음
UN-A3.atk: a calm draw on a high windy lookout, a faint star chime as the aim settles, then a precise arrow strike riding the wind
UN-A3.def: the stargazer has already read the blow: a quick sidestep, a soft rush of air, an incoming spell scattering into sparkles

UN-A3-7.ko: 주문 꿰는 화살 · 마력 삼켜 울림
UN-A3-7.atk: a sharp bowstring twang, an arrow piercing a humming glowing spell with a glassy crack, then a rushing pull of magic into the bow
UN-A3-7.def: the hunter draws incoming magic into the bow: a deep suction whoosh, a resonant swallowed hum, a low satisfied thrum of the string

EP-A3-1.ko: 별 문자 실은 바람 화살 · 바람이 되어 흩어짐
EP-A3-1.atk: a bright gust takes the shape of a bow, a whistling volley of wind arrows carrying star glyphs fans out and strikes with crisp scattered chimes
EP-A3-1.def: the sylph dissolves into breeze: a quick airy swish, the blow passing straight through, a soft whistle as she reforms

EP-A3-2.ko: 번개구름 고래 울음 · 첫 칼날 흩음
EP-A3-2.atk: a deep whale call rolls under thunder, storm clouds churn, then a lightning bolt splits from its body with a doubled thunderclap
EP-A3-2.def: a ring of thundercloud scatters the first blade: a crackling static burst, a soft cloudy whump, rumbling thunder fading

EP-A3-3.ko: 별빛 깃 쏟아냄 · 날개 펼쳐 관문처럼 막음
EP-A3-3.atk: huge silent wings unfurl, a deep echoing hoot, then a volley of starlit feathers rains down far and wide with ringing chimes
EP-A3-3.def: great wings spread like a gate: a heavy feathered thump, a calm low hoot, star dots shimmering across the plumage

PN-A3-C1.ko: 별 사냥개 달려 물기 · 별선이 버팀
PN-A3-C1.atk: a bay rings out like a struck crystal, star-dot paws patter with soft chimes, then a starlit bite snaps with a glassy click
PN-A3-C1.def: the blow passes between star points: a faint tinkling scatter, starlight lines flickering, a soft whine as they redraw

PN-A3-C3.ko: 날갯짓으로 먼 바람 화살 · 늘 같은 두께의 바람 결계
PN-A3-C3.atk: a griffin rears with a screech and beats its wings, a heavy shaft of wind flies far like a longbow shot and strikes with a deep thunk
PN-A3-C3.def: a wind barrier wraps the griffin: a steady roaring hum, the blow skidding off, barding plates clinking

PN-A3-U1.ko: 별 문자 깃 날려 보냄 · 버티는 바람
PN-A3-U1.atk: a soft hoot, a wing beat sends a glowing star-glyph feather whistling out, striking with a clear chime
PN-A3-U1.def: the owl braces in a steady current: a ruffle of feathers, a low hum of air, a calm blink

PN-A3-U2.ko: 관문 앞 급강하 · 둥지 지키듯 버팀
PN-A3-U2.atk: a screech from a high nest, a steep dive with a rising whistle, then talons pierce through armour with a sharp metallic crack
PN-A3-U2.def: the griffin stands its ground like a gatepost: a heavy feathered thud, a growl, claws scraping stone

PN-A3-R.ko: 곁의 화살이 휘어 듦 · 미리 본 듯 막음
PN-A3-R.atk: a captain's crisp command click, a volley of nearby bowstrings answering, arrows bending through the air with soft star chimes
PN-A3-R.def: the captain foresees the blow: a calm small sidestep, a glancing brush, a faint shimmer of watching eyes

PN-A3-E.ko: 스승의 별을 겨눔 · 버티며 별 읽음
PN-A3-E.atk: a reverent slow draw, a clear ringing twang, a starlit arrow rising with a long bright whistle and a soft celestial chime
PN-A3-E.def: the disciple holds steady under the blow: a firm padded thud, a quiet breath, the bowstring humming faintly

UP-A3-10.ko: 날개를 연달아 쳐 깃털 화살을 쏟음 · 단단히 떠서 버팀
UP-A3-10.atk: rapid strong wing beats fire a stream of feathers: a fast staccato of whistling quills, then a dense rattle of small piercing thunks
UP-A3-10.def: the harpy holds steady in the air: a firm wing snap, a few loose feathers fluttering, a sharp defiant shriek

UP-A3-11.ko: 질풍처럼 급강하해 발톱으로 낚아챔 · 바람 속에 비켜 섬
UP-A3-11.atk: great wings beat in a rushing gust, a piercing eagle-like screech, then a fast diving whoosh ends in a hard talon rake and a beak strike
UP-A3-11.def: the griffin sweeps aside on the wind: a powerful flap, a low leonine growl, the blow whooshing past through empty air

UP-A3-18.ko: 별빛 시위 둘이 한 소리로 울려 화살이 겹쳐 꽂힘 · 별선이 막음
UP-A3-18.atk: two starlit bowstrings hum together as one, a pair of shimmering arrows whistle off side by side and land in a doubled crystalline chime
UP-A3-18.def: a web of starlight lines snaps up to deflect: a bright double twang, chiming sparks, the star lines flickering and holding

UP-A3-23.ko: 별여우가 길목에서 튀어나와 꼬리로 휘둘러 묾 · 별빛 남기고 비킴
UP-A3-23.atk: a sudden hush on a mountain trail, then light paws burst from the side, a sharp yip, a starlit tail sweeps with a twinkling chime and a quick hard bite
UP-A3-23.def: the fox bounds clear: a soft scrabble of paws on stone, a trail of starlight shimmer, a calm low bark

UP-A3-24.ko: 깃부채 신호에 번개 화살이 줄줄이 · 뇌운이 받아 삼킴
UP-A3-24.atk: a crow-like caw of command, a feather fan snaps open, several bowstrings crackle together and lightning arrows land in a rolling series of electric cracks
UP-A3-24.def: a thick storm cloud swallows the hit: a deep cloudy whump, a fizz of static, black feathers rustling

MA-03.cast: a cold draining sigh: a thin hiss of air slipping out, a limp muscle-slackening sink in pitch, then a faint soft clatter as strength drops away

SA3-04.cast: many bowstrings creak tight together to full draw, a long tense hum of pulled wood, then a single sharp unified snap

MA-11.cast: a calm aimed draw, a crisp twang, two arrows whistling down onto staggering foes with heavy final thunks

SA3-06.ko: 무기고 문이 열리고 활이 한 자루씩 쥐어짐
SA3-06.cast: a heavy wooden armory door groans open, a rack of bows clattering as they are handed out one by one, then a ripple of bowstrings being tested with bright twangs and a rising wind

SA3-08.ko: 전장 가득 몸 가누기 힘든 바람
SA3-08.cast: a vast wind rises across a field, banners snapping, a long deep howl with rolling thunder, then a heavy stilling pressure drop

RA3-1.cast: a roar of wind spins up around, then suddenly drops to a vacuum-like hush, a faint ringing in the stillness and a soft draining tick

NA3-1.cast: a narrow keening wind picks at plate seams with tiny tin rattles, rivets popping, then metal flaps like cloth in a ragged hiss

NA3-2.cast: a massed volley of bowstrings released high, a rising swarm of whistling arrows arcing overhead, then a pattering rain of thunks behind a shield wall

NA3-3.cast: many bowstrings drawn and released together as one deep thrum, a shimmering swarm of star-bright arrows whistling upward with a crystalline chime, then a wide rain of glittering impacts across the whole field

NA3-4.ko: 사냥 뿔피리 · 바람 탄 화살 폭풍
NA3-4.cast: a deep hunting horn blast, a roaring gust sweeping the field, then a dense storm of arrows hissing down everywhere in rolling waves

HA3-1.cast: hurried footsteps falling back, a covering volley of bowstrings snapping, arrows thudding into raised weapons and forcing them down

HA3-2.cast: a soft rustle of a folded scout's note, a quiet whispered breeze, then a cord pulled tight with a short creaking snap

US-A3-2.cast: a thousand lids open with soft wet flutters, a vast deep pressure hum settles, then drawn blades and spells freeze with a sharp stillness

PS-A3-1.cast: three soft chime ticks rotate in circle, a wheeling whirr of air, a wooden gear clicking, then a hollow settling thud

PS-A3-2.cast: a quill scratch as a copy is written, a rising swirling hum, then glowing pulses press into allies with soft resonant pings

RS-A3-1.cast: two slim blades of wind whistle in sharp succession, each ends in a dry cutting snap on cloth, the second higher than the first

RS-A3-2.cast: a reverse howl blows hard down the stair, blades blunt against a wall of air and rebound with a whipping slap and a rough cutting hiss

RS-A3-3.cast: a roaring cyclone thick with thin ringing blades, rapid slicing zips in a spinning flurry, then a deepening lowering sink of weakened air

CS-A3.cast: a spell hums into being, a thin taut thread of sound is cut with a bright snip, then it fizzles and dies with a soft puff

C2-1.equip: a short wooden bow is flexed and a fresh string hooked on with a light click, then a soft testing twang

C3-1.equip: a bowstring is drawn and a small storm crackles along it, a gust swirls, a tiny zap of lightning sparks at the tip

IA3-3.equip: a light cloak is swung over the shoulders, wind wraps around it with a soft swirling whoosh, a clasp clicks shut

IA3-4.equip: a quiver strap is buckled, arrows rattle inside, and a small whirl of wind rises as one arrow is drawn out

IA3-5.equip: a tall divine longbow is lifted, its string drawn and released empty with a deep resonant hum and a faint starry chime

IA3-6.equip: a bundle of arrows is slid into a quiver, their fletching crackling with static, a small thunder pop as they settle

SR-A3.equip: a long quill is dipped and tapped on an inkwell, a scratch of nib on vellum, a swelling resonant hum, and an authoritative amplified snap of air

IR-A3.equip: an arrow is turned in the hand, glyphs along the shaft glow with a soft rising shimmer, a gentle breeze bending around it

PI-A3.equip: a strand of starlight is twisted and hooked onto a bow, a clear glassy hum rings out and then holds perfectly still

TS-A3-1.cast: a tiny glittering streak falls with a high thin whistle, then a brief crystalline ping and a faint scatter of fine dust

TS-A3-2.cast: a squat twister spins up in an eager whirr, grit rattling, then strikes one target with a sudden whipping slap

TS-A3-3.cast: a faint dry spark popping from stirred air, a brief glowing sizzle, then a little tick against the foremost armor

TS-A3-4.cast: a single clear tap that echoes back as a second softer one, two light impacts bouncing off front lines with a hollow ring
